newsitem.title: USA: Airtouch expects new clients to rise 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Airtouch expects new clients to rise 20 pct.

text.p: AirTouch Communications said Tuesday it expects to beat last year's record of one million new cellular customers worldwide by at least 20 percent, adding that its AirTouch Paging business should also post record customer growth for the year.
The company said it has had operating cash flow margins in the low- to mid-40s range since 1992.

The company said its mature international operations, exclusive of start-ups, earned $31 million in net income in the first half 1996. For the same period in 1995 these operations suffered a loss of $12.7 million, said company spokeswoman Susan Rosenberg.
"Now that those operations are becoming profitable, we expect they'll be paying dividends back to the owners," Rosenberg said.

The company said that since the spin-off from Pacific Telesis in April of 1994, it has increased its customers by 135 percent, increased its net revenues by 137 percent and increased its net income 118 percent.
